status: actual registered source schemas; no handlers executed

tools.name: movies_search
tools.description: Search movie and TV titles through the installed Luffy bridge using your Hermes-managed TMDB API v3 key. Show title/year/kind and select the exact ID; never silently choose a remake or a different series.

tools.name: movies_details
tools.description: Show a selected title and season/episode metadata using your Hermes-managed TMDB API v3 key when refresh is needed. Metadata does not prove stream availability. Cached for 24 hours unless refresh is requested.

identifier.description: Exact movie-N or tv-N ID selected from movies_search.

tools.name: movies_play
tools.description: Play the selected movie or TV episode in local mpv on the Hermes host. Only use when the user requests playback; this opens a window and plays sound. Movies use season0/episode0. TV requires explicit season and episode. Preserves HLS master playlists and source headers. Linux development build.

identifier.description: Exact movie-N or tv-N ID selected from movies_search.

tools.name: movies_status
tools.description: Read actual plugin-owned player status and observed progress.

tools.name: movies_control
tools.description: Pause, unpause, seek or stop only this plugin's own player session.

tools.name: movies_history
tools.description: Show this profile's local movie/TV viewing history, with source and saved positions.

tools.name: movies_resume
tools.description: Continue a requested movie/TV session from observed progress using fresh links. An optional source change preserves the position. Advances TV after natural completion; completed movies require an explicit replay.

identifier.description: Exact movie-N or tv-N ID selected from movies_search.
